metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to slide 2 in LibreOffice Impress, selected the dim background image, set brightness to 50% via Properties panel, then saved the adjusted image via right-click to Desktop as background.png.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select images in Impress, adjust brightness via Properties panel, save images, and edit slide text content.
metadata.explanation: Composes the original image-brightness+export task with a slide title edit. Evaluator awards 0.5 for background.png existing on Desktop AND image brightness confirmed at ~50% via PPTX XML <a:lum bright> attribute, and 0.5 for slide 2 title changed to 'Enhanced Slide' in the saved PPTX. [Fixed: replaced 8-char hash suffix '510c09db' with full 32-char MD5 '9880fcd0ac1db0e1d57c564194f1780a'; replaced hardcoded shape name 'Rectangle 15' with robust title lookup (shapes.title → placeholder idx=0 → text content match); added brightness verification via PPTX XML <a:lum bright> attribute (50000 = 50% in OOXML 1/1000-percent units, tolerance ±5%)]
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced invalid 8-char hash suffix '510c09db' with correct 32-char MD5 hash '9880fcd0ac1db0e1d57c564194f1780a' (computed from '4c26e3f3-3a14-4d86-b44a-d3cedebbb487|0') in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

Fix 2: Replaced hardcoded shape name lookup ('Rectangle 15') in getter with three-stage robust title lookup: (1) slide2.shapes.title, (2) iterate shapes checking placeholder_format.idx==0, (3) iterate text frames matching 'SLIDE TITLE' or 'ENHANCED SLIDE'

Fix 3: Added brightness verification to getter: reads PPTX XML <a:lum bright> attribute for the picture shape on slide 2 and sets brightness_ok=True when bright value is 50000 ± 5000 (i.e., 50% ± 5% in OOXML 1/1000-percent units). Metric sub-goal 1 now requires file_exists AND brightness_ok for the 0.5 credit.

scoring_breakdown.file_exists_and_brightness_ok: 0.5 - background.png saved to Desktop AND image brightness ~50% verified in PPTX XML

llm_judge_reasons: All three instruction requirements are covered: (1) background.png file existence on Desktop, (2) image brightness ~50% verified via PPTX XML <a:lum bright> attribute (50000 = 50% in OOXML 1/1000-percent units, ±5% tolerance), and (3) slide 2 title changed to 'Enhanced Slide'.

The three-method robust title lookup (shapes.title → placeholder idx==0 → text content match) correctly addresses the prior hardcoded shape name issue and will work across different PPTX title storage formats.

Brightness verification via PPTX XML is a valid proxy: LibreOffice Impress writes the <a:lum bright> attribute when the user adjusts brightness in the Properties panel, so checking this attribute correctly confirms the 50% setting was applied.
The metric uses case-insensitive comparison for the title (strip().lower()) and reads expected_title correctly from the rule config, making it semantically sound.
The postconfig runs Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure the presentation is saved, which is essential for file-based state verification.
Minor concern: the getter only checks the first picture shape on slide 2 (break after first match) — if a non-target picture precedes the target image, brightness_ok may remain False.

Minor concern: shape_type check (13, 14) covers standard PICTURE/LINKED_PICTURE types; LibreOffice might occasionally store image shapes with a different type, potentially causing the brightness check to be skipped.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove the bare `break` after processing the first picture shape and instead iterate all picture shapes, updating brightness_ok if any picture has the correct brightness. This handles slides with multiple images.

As a fallback for LibreOffice-saved PPTX, also check shape_type == 6 (GROUP) or use shape.element.tag to search for pic:pic elements, in case LibreOffice wraps images in group containers that cause shape_type to differ from 13/14.
